status.summary: Ranked #6 at middleweight. Lost for the first time in about a decade to Nassourdine Imavov (UD, UFC Paris, Sep 6, 2025), then beat Reinier de Ridder 30-27 on all cards at UFC 326 (Mar 7, 2026). style.summary: A southpaw who now leads with striking (86.5% of decayed sig landed comes at distance), mixing straight punches with body and leg kicks while keeping a grappling and top-control threat in reserve. He is very hard to hurt and builds momentum slowly, so he tends to win late rounds and sometimes gives away early ones.

moves.notes: Target groups follow fighters.json decayed sums: sig attempts 70.8% head, 17.6% body, 11.6% leg (career 71.4/17.5/11.0). The middleweight league split is about 77/14/9, so he works the body and legs more than average. No scouting source reachable in this pass broke down his individual techniques, so the within-group split is a southpaw default. The rear-hand straight leads the head group and the lead-hand jab follows. Body kicks lead the body group, assuming the open-side kick of a southpaw, though ufcstats does not separate punches from kicks. Leg kicks are split evenly. Knee and elbow are minimal because his clinch share is under 4% of sig landed. No spinning attacks are recorded. Treat these weights as low confidence.
